title: Product
summary: Product scope for a browser-based Lineage II client with an editable Babylon.js world, native Interlude assets, audio, rendering direction, and phase boundaries.
notes: Type PRD is authoritative from MANIFEST_TYPE (manifest_override true). Owner and dated decisions and work-order statements in the source, for synthesizer conflict detection: (1) Section 'Rendering direction - 2026-11-07': 'Use modern Babylon.js WebGPU rendering'; 'Reproduce old Direct3D details only when they explain a meaningful visible difference or required behavior'; 'Begin a representative baseline now'; 'Existing fidelity and hardware acceptance thresholds remain unchanged'. (2) Section 'Capabilities and constraints': 'The user's 2026-11-06 1:1 requirement includes original Interlude audio, with native timing, selection, looping, volume and spatial/listener behavior'. (3) Section 'Capabilities and constraints': 'The asset structure guides the client implementation'; 'valid content must not be renamed, flattened, rebaked or uniformly resized'; 'Conversion changes require a demonstrated defect or loss of required source structure'. (4) Section 'Current documentation and asset work': 'The user's latest priority is the visible native world with actors and FPS'; 'The earlier 2026-11-05 priority established reusable raw native migration before playable assembly'; 'It does not defer baseline/optimization work on supported content under the current rendering direction'. (5) Section 'Current documentation and asset work': 'the subsequent terrain task expressly forbids service changes and production deployment'. (6) Section 'Current documentation and asset work': 'The user's request to fix stale files refers to Markdown (.md), not stylesheets.' (7) Section 'Phase 2': 'Real M0 networking, still planned: establish Interlude authentication, character selection and world entry against stock Mobius'; networking, progression and deployment are absent from Phase 1. (8) Section 'Interface commitment': 'The user selected a game-like scene with compact controls'; 'Mobile first'; 'Show actual screenshots at visible implementation milestones'. Section 'Users and purpose' and 'Capabilities and constraints' also state that the legacy demo has exactly six initial characters and that the native Interlude route requires its real actor packages and world.
